people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
translations.bsb: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
translations.kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
translations.asv: If ye died with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, do ye subject yourselves to ordinances,
